meta.title: Find Your Main: What Your League Champion Says About You
meta.description: Take a funny League of Legends personality quiz and discover which champion matches your playstyle. Eight absurd questions, three champion recommendations, zero login.

intro.title: Find Your Main
intro.h1: What League of Legends champion should you play?
intro.subtitle: Eight questionable decisions later, we'll tell you who you really are.
intro.lead: Absurd League situations, zero serious questions, and a champion recommendation that will explain a little too much about you.
intro.noLogin: 2 minutes · 8 questions · no login · no judgement (okay, some judgement)
intro.rouletteLink: Not ready for self-discovery? Spin the roulette instead.
intro.howText: Every answer quietly scores twelve playstyle traits: aggression, mechanics, patience, creativity, teamwork, carry instinct, dueling, ranged combat, control, scaling, mobility and protection. We compare your trait profile with a curated set of champion profiles. Same answers always produce the same result. No win rates, no tier lists, no invented statistics.
intro.howDisclaimer: This is entertainment, not a psychological assessment. Your main is a vibe match, not a diagnosis.

faq.a: No. It is a personality quiz built on League situations. The only peer-reviewed part is the grey screen.

faq.q: How are the three champions chosen?
faq.a: Your answers create a hidden playstyle profile. We compare it with champion profiles, then pick a main, an alternate from a different angle, and a wildcard that still fits.
No. Answer the questions, get roasted gently, and share the result. Accounts are only for the main roulette and its match tracking.

faq.q: Will this improve my ranked games?
faq.a: It will improve your ability to explain your pick in champ select. Results may vary. Your jungler may still be farming.

ui.answerHint: Pick the one that feels dangerously accurate.

ui.invalidShare: That shared result link was incomplete or invalid, so we started fresh. The champions forgive you.
ui.spin: Not convinced by your destiny? Spin the roulette.
ui.spinSub: Let the randomizer decide. It has no feelings and no mercy.
ui.footerTagline: Find your main. Question your choices.
ui.resultReveal: The void has consulted your answers.

insights.aggression: You treat every cooldown as a permission slip.
insights.mechanics: You would rather fail a flashy play than succeed at a boring one.
insights.patience: You can wait. You just prefer not to announce it.
insights.creativity: If the obvious play is available, you assume it is a trap.
insights.teamwork: You genuinely want your teammates to survive. A radical position in SoloQ.
insights.carry: You see a fight and think, 'I could be the main character here.'
insights.dueling: You take '1v1 me' as a personal invitation, not a warning.
insights.ranged: Personal space is not a preference. It is a build.
insights.control: You like fights to happen where you planned them, not where they happened.
insights.scaling: You believe the first 20 minutes are just the tutorial.
insights.mobility: Walls are suggestions. Death timers are consequences.
insights.protection: You would rather save one idiot than avenge three. Honestly? Respect.

yasuo.title: The Protagonist Syndrome
yasuo.quote: The grey screen is not a death. It is your personal loading screen.

zed.title: The Edgy Group Project
zed.quote: You said you would share the kill. You shared the grey screen.

katarina.title: The Human Respawn Timer
katarina.quote: Your plan has three steps: go in, press everything, apologize later.

jinx.title: The Walking Incident Report
jinx.quote: You don't start fights. You create situations that require an emergency response team.

vayne.title: The 1v9 Auditor
vayne.quote: You keep a mental spreadsheet of every enemy who touched your minions. It has no mercy.

ezreal.title: The Main Character With a Map
ezreal.quote: You are lost, but you are confident, and honestly that is half the battle.

ahri.title: The Charm Offensive
ahri.quote: You make chaos look elegant, then leave before anyone can ask questions.

orianna.title: The Control Freak With a Ball
orianna.quote: Your team has a plan. It is your plan. The ball is just there to enforce it.

xerath.title: The Artillery Accountant
xerath.quote: You do not enter fights. You file them under 'resolved from three screens away.'

thresh.title: The Friendly Neighbourhood Nightmare
thresh.quote: Your idea of helping is occasionally throwing someone into danger with a lantern.

braum.title: The Team's Emotional Support Wall
braum.quote: You may not make the highlight reel, but everyone in it owes you their life.

leona.title: The Sun-Powered Babysitter
leona.quote: You saw your team make a bad decision and decided to make it with them. Loudly.

darius.title: The Dunk Minister
darius.quote: Your love language is applying a five-stack axe to a disagreement.

teemo.title: The War Criminal of the Top Lane
teemo.quote: You are not evil. You just enjoy watching someone step on a mushroom and rethink their life.

lulu.title: The Chaotic Godmother
lulu.quote: You solve problems by turning them into smaller, funnier problems.

sion.title: The Undead Freight Train
sion.quote: You have two speeds: dead and arriving anyway.

garen.title: The spin-to-win diplomat
garen.quote: Your plan is simple: run at the problem, spin, and let regeneration handle the paperwork.

malphite.title: The one-button earthquake
malphite.quote: You don't start fights. You schedule earthquakes and let everyone else fill in the agenda.

fiora.title: The vital-point prosecutor
fiora.quote: You don't argue with your lane opponent. You file a formal complaint with their vitals.

leesin.title: The blindfolded highlight reel
leesin.quote: You have never met a ward you didn't want to jump to and a teammate you didn't want to kick into danger.

warwick.title: The bloodhound of bad decisions
warwick.quote: You don't gank lanes. You follow the scent of someone who overstayed.

sejuani.title: The permafrost nanny
sejuani.quote: You bring the whole team to the fight, whether they asked or not. Mostly not.

syndra.title: The orb hoarder
syndra.quote: You don't chase kills. You collect them, arrange them neatly, and throw them at the next problem.

akali.title: The smoke-screen introvert
akali.quote: Your communication style is a smoke bomb and a very confident dash.

veigar.title: The tiny tyrant of scaling
veigar.quote: You spend 25 minutes being harmless, then invoice the entire enemy team at once.

caitlyn.title: The headshot landlord
caitlyn.quote: You don't fight fair. You fight from a distance that would require a permission slip.

jhin.title: The four-act drama
jhin.quote: You don't take fights. You compose them in four movements and critique the enemy's posture.

kaisa.title: The evolved carry
kaisa.quote: You are a scaling investment with wings. Your team just has to survive the quarterly report.

nami.title: The bubble dispatcher
nami.quote: You solve problems by making them wet, confused, and slightly better positioned.

nautilus.title: The hook with a body
nautilus.quote: Your love language is a hook, a slow, and a team that finally arrives on time.

rakan.title: The feathery instigator
rakan.quote: You are not the main character. You are the main character's extremely theatrical support.

soraka.title: The health bar philanthropist
soraka.quote: You would heal a burning building if it asked nicely. You have the mana for it.

q1.prompt: It's 2:37 AM. Your friend says, 'One last game.' What's your move?

options.q1a: Fine, but I have to wake up early tomorrow.
options.q1b: One more, but I'm carrying this one.
options.q1c: Only if we run a completely absurd strategy.
options.q1d: I'm leaving. I have dignity, sleep, and responsibilities.
options.q1e: I accept, but I'm trying a champion I've never touched.

q2.prompt: Your team has just walked into an impossible fight one by one. Four enemies are left and you're behind a wall. What do you do?

options.q2a: I go in anyway. If they die, we die together.
options.q2b: I wait for my moment and delete the enemy carry.
options.q2c: I look for a play so absurd it becomes a clip.
options.q2d: I try to save the survivors. Someone has to be the adult.
options.q2e: I take two towers while they make a nature documentary.

q3.prompt: What instantly turns you into the villain of the game?

options.q3a: The enemy jungler appears in my lane for the third time.
options.q3b: Someone steals a kill I had already celebrated.
options.q3c: My team ignores a play I spent 15 minutes planning.
options.q3d: I die with an ability ready.
options.q3e: Nobody protects the carry while I try to keep everyone alive.
options.q3f: The enemy thinks they can win a duel against me.

q4.prompt: Pick one completely unnecessary superpower for the Rift. Responsibility is not included.

options.q4a: Appear behind anyone when they least expect it.
options.q4b: Have a shield for absolutely everything.
options.q4c: Turn a lost fight into a pentakill.
options.q4d: Control the map like I have X-ray vision.
options.q4f: Make enemies regret coming near me.

q5.prompt: Everyone has flaws. What's yours when you play?

options.q5a: If I can go in, I go in. Getting out is a later problem.
options.q5b: I never forget a humiliation. Revenge will come.
options.q5c: My play has to go exactly as I imagined it.
options.q5d: I like winning, but I also want the enemy to suffer a little.
options.q5e: I spend so much time helping that I forget to farm.
options.q5f: If there's a weird way to win, I'll find it.

q6.prompt: All your weekend plans get cancelled. What do you improvise?

options.q6a: Learn a combo that will take three days to execute.
options.q6b: Play calmly and accidentally become MVP.
options.q6c: Turn a normal game into a story I'll tell for years.
options.q6d: Try a questionable strategy that surprisingly works.
options.q6e: Play with friends and make sure everyone has fun.
options.q6f: Climb. Rest is for after Challenger.

q7.prompt: The enemy just locked in their main and is spamming mastery. What's your reaction?

options.q7a: Perfect. I want them confident before I destroy them.
options.q7b: I pick something that makes them regret existing in this lane.
options.q7c: I study their moves and outsmart them.
options.q7d: I don't care who it is. My plan stays the same.
options.q7e: I pick something weird. Let them figure out what's happening.
options.q7f: I wish them luck. After all, it's just a game... mostly.

q8.prompt: A narrator has to give you a legendary title. Which one fits you best?

options.q8a: The protagonist of a fight nobody asked for.
options.q8b: The nightmare that appears from the fog.
options.q8c: The brain behind an inexplicable victory.
options.q8d: The guardian who keeps the team alive.
options.q8e: The monster that starts calm and ends unstoppable.
options.q8f: The misunderstood genius playing something nobody knows how to counter.

result.mainWhy: {champion} is your main because your answers lean into {traits}. As a {class} in the {role} role, {champion} turns that into {playstyle}.
result.alternateWhy: Same instincts, different angle. {champion} gives your {traits} another place to cause problems from the {role} role.
result.wildcardWhy: Your wildcard. {champion} still fits your {traits}, but nobody on your team saw this pick coming.
result.answerNotesTitle: Where your answers gave you away
result.disclaimer: For entertainment only. Not a psychological assessment, not a Riot statistic, and definitely not a promise that your team will follow your engage.
result.retakeHint: New answers, new destiny. The champions are not emotionally attached.

playstyle.Fighter: walking into every fight slightly before it officially begins
playstyle.Assassin: turning a quiet lane into a missing-person poster
playstyle.Mage: making the battlefield happen exactly where you planned it
playstyle.Marksman: deleting health bars from a disrespectful distance
playstyle.Tank: being the reason your team survives its own decisions
playstyle.Support: making everyone else look like they know what they're doing
